title: Weekly leadership huddle
description: A 20-minute standing check-in to surface blockers early and keep priorities aligned.

title: Decision log
description: Record major decisions, owners, and rationale in one shared place so context is never lost.

title: Quarterly learning sprint
description: Set aside one week each quarter for the team to study a shared topic.

title: Mentor pairing
description: Pair every senior leader with an emerging leader for monthly conversations.

title: Customer advisory panel
description: Meet a rotating panel of customers every quarter to test our direction.

title: Public progress report
description: Publish a short, plain-language update on goals and results twice a year.

title: Simplify approvals
description: Cut approval steps for spending under a set threshold.

title: Shared dashboard
description: One dashboard of the five numbers the whole team agrees matter most.
